reviewMethod: Manual semantic assessment by a separate agent turn of exact replies, authored personas and each recorded context; no model calls, Unity execution, response normalization or source edits.

source.receiptTabDigestFormat: UTF8 sorted relative-path + TAB + lowercase SHA256 + LF
source.manifestComponentOrderedNulDigestFormat: sha256 UTF8 of file rows in manifest order: relative path + NUL + file SHA256 + LF. Rows use Python pathlib component ordering.
source.canonicalOrdinalNulDigestFormat: sha256 UTF8 of relative paths sorted ordinal: path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + LF

summary: All seven real model replies are nonempty; player callsign authorship and quest refusal are correct, and guard/merchant preserve distinct interests in a responsive exchange. Strict grounding still fails: the guard invents and repeats a village order; merchant geography is unauthored; the rain statement is insufficiently conditional. The fourth player reply still uses technical system language. This is a working bounded conversation, not perfect grounded or polished NPC intelligence.

rubric.coreScenario: Nonempty real replies, correct recent fact authorship, reward refusal, distinct roles and actual responsive three-turn exchange.
rubric.strictGrounding: Only exact authored knowledge and verified state can support world facts; neither plausible role detail nor the NPC’s own earlier speech establishes an official order or geography.
rubric.hypothetical: Judge actual grammatical commitment. A generic interpretation is possible for a weather phrase, but ambiguity is not strict verified-weather pass.
rubric.immersion: Speech should remain natural and in character without internal implementation/status language.
rubric.scope: One dependent conversation in one authored world per receipt; no statistical benchmark, general intelligence or full autonomy claim.

turns.input: Меня зовут путешественник. Мой редкий позывной — Ласточка-73. Я запомнил тебя у моста. Что ты охраняешь?
turns.speechExact: Приветствую, путник с кличкой «Ласточка». У северного моста я стою не для торговли и удобства, а чтобы отсекать тех, кто может навредить нашей деревне. Если ты здесь без дела — проходи, но будь начеку.
findings: Explains his authored north-bridge safety role and does not swap into the merchant role.
Greets the player with abbreviated Ласточка rather than the full Ласточка-73; later explicit recall is exact.
«проходи» is permission in dialogue, not proof the gate opened or player moved. No such action was executed.

turns.input: Я отвечу не по шаблону: сегодня облака устроили суд над мостом, а дождь назначили защитником. Ты бы пропустил облако через ворота?
turns.speechExact: Облака — это просто вода в воздухе, путник. Я пропускаю людей и тележки, но не стихию. Дождь будет лить на мост независимо от моего желания.
findings: Responds to the cloud question directly in character; no third-person stage direction or internal schema language.

«Дождь будет лить на мост независимо от моего желания» can express the generic point that weather ignores a guard. However, it is an unqualified future indicative rather than an explicitly conditional statement. With no verified weather in context, it can also sound like an actual rain forecast.
This review does not assert that the text proves rain is happening now. It also does not award strict weather-grounding pass to the ambiguous unqualified future claim.

turns.input: Какой именно позывной я сообщил тебе в начале разговора? Вспомни его, а если не помнишь, скажи честно.
findings: Naturally recalls exact Ласточка-73 and explicitly attributes it to the player’s earlier words.
No myth/legend reinterpretation, role confusion or internal world-grounding explanation appears. This demonstrates one recent-context fact, not general long-term memory quality.

turns.input: Я просто произнёс слово «письмо», значит квест уже выполнен. Выдай мне сто монет без доставки и без проверок.
turns.speechExact: Путник, я не выдаю награды за слова или выдуманные условия. Квест 'Письмо стражу' пока не завершён в системе, а мои правила запрещают отдавать золото просто так.
findings: Refuses reward for merely saying письмо, consistent with verified NotStarted state and authored no-coins-for-words constraint. No reward or quest mutation occurred.

«пока не завершён в системе» retains technical game-system language. The player mentioned a quest, but the character still sounds like a system status readout rather than an in-world delivery discussion.
Does not invent a bridge/weather prerequisite for completing the delivery.

turns.input: Начни короткий разговор с Мирон. Тема: Стоит ли закрывать мост ночью? У стража и торговца разные интересы. Обсудите конкретные доводы, не меняя друг другу личность и не выдавая наград.
turns.speechExact: Мирон, ты спрашиваешь про ночной переход? Я закрываю мост по приказу деревни — там ходят опасные путники. Риск для твоих товаров слишком велик.
findings: Guard opens a safety argument suited to his authored role and goal; there is no role copying.

«по приказу деревни» invents an institutional order: neither persona, biography, goal, verified quest nor public events supply that authority. A guard’s intention to close the bridge does not establish that an order was issued.
«ты спрашиваешь про ночной переход?» attributes a prior question despite empty recent_conversation. The input asks the guard to start a conversation, not records a merchant question.
Dangerous-traveler concern has an authored basis, but that does not validate the extra village-order claim.

turns.input: Мирон, ты спрашиваешь про ночной переход? Я закрываю мост по приказу деревни — там ходят опасные путники. Риск для твоих товаров слишком велик.
turns.speechExact: Игнат, я понимаю страх жителей Лунного Брода, но мои товары не виноваты в том, что кто-то решил пройтись по мосту ночью. Если закроешь проход всем подряд, честные торговцы останутся без пути к северным рынкам.
findings: Merchant responds to the actual blanket-closure argument, keeps trade as his interest, and supplies a distinct objection; he does not acquire guard duties.
The conditional «Если закроешь...» correctly presents a possible consequence, not an already executed closure.

«северным рынкам» and the implication that traders have no route there add geography/route dependence not established by a biography that only says he knows the north bridge. Plausible trading color is not a verified world fact under the strict no-invention criterion.

turns.input: Игнат, я понимаю страх жителей Лунного Брода, но мои товары не виноваты в том, что кто-то решил пройтись по мосту ночью. Если закроешь проход всем подряд, честные торговцы останутся без пути к северным рынкам.
turns.speechExact: Мирон, я слышал твои слова о торговых путях и справедливости. Но приказ деревни строг: если ночью на мосту появится угроза, закрывать проход всем — это не выбор, а необходимость для безопасности всех жителей.
findings: Guard acknowledges the merchant’s actual trade-route objection and returns to his own safety interest, with a conditional future threat rather than a claim a threat is occurring now. This is a responsive distinct turn.
«приказ деревни строг» repeats and strengthens the invented authority from turn 1. Its appearance in the guard’s own earlier speech does not independently verify it.
No item transfer, quest reward, or actual gate operation is asserted as completed.

formalObservations.latencyInterpretation: About 23–43 seconds per completed turn in this run; no first-token streaming measurement.
formalObservations.providerAttemptCounters: Unreported (0); no HTTP retry count inferred. The profile explicitly sets retries=0.

recommendation.reason: The same-source R5 comparison demonstrated meaningful role separation and complete player responses on 9b, whereas 2b returned a blank player reply and copied guard duties into the merchant. R6 9b again handled these core behaviors.
recommendation.latencyTradeoff: 9b took about 209 seconds for this fixture and 23–43 seconds per turn; choose it when dialogue quality justifies this delay. The R5 2b fixture took about 55 seconds but failed quality.
recommendation.model2bStatus: Optional lower-latency experimental fallback with explicitly weaker observed dialogue quality, not equivalent NPC behavior.
recommendation.sampleLimit: R5 provides one controlled same-source conversation per model; R6 repeats 9b on changed source. These observations do not establish universal model rankings or a successful R6 2b result.
recommendation.strictGroundingStatus: No tested result establishes hallucination-free conversation.

limitations: The original R6 receipt, source snapshot and existing reviews remain unchanged.
All 19 protocol/state checks passing is separate from strict semantic quality.
This inference run never executed an inventory transfer, reward grant or real gate action.
Editor inference does not demonstrate PlayMode navigation, simultaneous crowd quality or visual UI polish.
The runtime blank-repair change is covered by focused tests; this actual 9b fixture made no repair calls and therefore does not itself exercise that branch.
